Warrior, a special code has given you access to one of our outpost locations. You will access this secure area through a series of back door hacks connected by white hallways. Follow the door markers carefully, or you could get lost in the maze of corridors.

If the mission aborts unexpectedly while you are still in the outpost, you may lose your access, and have no way out. In this eventuality, you may have to terminate your RSI and reconstruct in the Loading Area.

briefing_lines.text:
I am never pleased to order an assassination, but sometimes our situation leaves us little choice.

To reach {target} we'll need find out where they are hiding. Go to this address, meet with {npc} and give them an escort. They should impart {target}'s location once this is done.

While overt conflict serves its purpose, sometimes a more subtle approach is required. In this case, an assassination.

To reach {target} we'll need find out where they are hiding. Go to this address, meet with {npc} and give them an escort. They should impart {target}'s location once this is done.

While overt conflict serves its purpose, sometimes a more subtle approach is required. In this case, an assassination.

The problem is that we don't know exactly where Agent {target} is now. You may be able to find some clues at the location I have downloaded to you.

It is not my intention to create cynicism in my operatives, but I'm afraid this mission is quite unpleasant. An assassination is called for, and the duty falls to you, {player}.

The first step to finding {target} is accessing a secure network for intelligence. We know this will aid you, but we don't know where to find it. At this location there are clues about where this secure system can be accessed. Do your best to find it, {player}.

While overt conflict serves its purpose, sometimes a more subtle approach is required. In this case, an assassination.

In order to reach {target}, you will first need to acquire a certin Data Disk that holds details on {target}'s position. My sources say it can be found at the address I just marked for you.

Your mission is to eradicate someone from the Matrix; to delete them, if you will. I do hope you can handle this, Mr. Anderson. 

The location of {target} is not known by us. It is stored on a secure server, whose location is also secret. Locate the server, and get the intel we require to find {target}.

briefing_lines.text:
Welcome to the Matrix, {player}! I am Tyndall and I will be your mission contact from Zion. I've been looking forward to working with you. 

Your first objective is displayed on your HUD. The number on the waypoint tells you your current distance from the mission location. Go there now and talk to {npc}.

dialog_lines.text: What {npc} says is true. New redpills have limited access rights. If you see an Agent, run!

Inside this building you'll find one of the many Zion bases within the Matrix. Zion uses these bases to stock supplies, create tools and even locate potential redpills. 

Find {npc}. After speaking with {npc} and {npc}, {npc} will want to see you in combat.
Once all of your objectives are complete, you and your team must exit the mission area. We don't want hostile Agents tracking you.

Some Exiles in the Matrix have formed gangs. They roam the streets and alleyways of the city. That doesn't mean you can't fight them, just be careful.

Hey, speaking of fighting... I want to see you in combat! Fight this simulacrum of mine. Show me what you've learned!

Tyndall says you need a little advice now that you've been freed. 

Most important: Stay alive. The Machines and who knows who else will be gunning for you. Don't ever assume that you're safe, especially once you leave Richland.

Nice work, {player}! There's one more thing I wanted to tell you before you go.

Exile gangs have staked out territory in the Matrix, and might attack if you come close. Your targeting HUD colors their names based on their threat level. I won't go into all the details, but if you see purple, run!
Damn! I see your combat training has paid off.

You just completed your first mission. I know it was easy, but things won't always be so simple. Trust me.

Exit the building and we can wrap up your first assignment.

I already see that it'll be a pleasure working with you, {player}.

Contact me when you are ready for your next assignment, Warrior.
Why don't we play along with {npc}? I've already added your new objective: Kill the simulacrum!
Once you've completed your objectives for a mission, don't stay in the mission area. If you loiter at the mission area for too long it's possible that Agents will track you and chase you down!

Command accepted!
Simulacrum is ready for combat.
I am a simulacrum. Only {npc} may issue me commands.

briefings.text:
Welcome to the Matrix, mxoemu3! I am Tyndall and I will be your mission contact from Zion. I've been looking forward to working with you. 

Your first objective is displayed on your HUD. The number on the waypoint tells you your current distance from the mission location. Go there now and talk to Regulus.

dialog.text:
Inside this building you'll find one of the many Zion bases within the Matrix. Zion uses these bases to stock supplies, create tools and even locate potential redpills. 

Find Regulus. After speaking with Regulus and Rarahu, Armor will want to see you in combat.

dialog.speaker: Regulus
dialog.text:
Tyndall says you need a little advice now that you've been freed. 

Most important: Stay alive. The Machines and who knows who else will be gunning for you. Don't ever assume that you're safe, especially once you leave Richland.
What Regulus says is true. New redpills have limited access rights. If you see an Agent, run!

dialog.speaker: Rarahu
dialog.text: Once you've completed your objectives for a mission, don't stay in the mission area. If you loiter at the mission area for too long it's possible that Agents will track you and chase you down!
Once all of your objectives are complete, you and your team must exit the mission area. We don't want hostile Agents tracking you.

dialog.speaker: Armor
dialog.text:
Some Exiles in the Matrix have formed gangs. They roam the streets and alleyways of the city. That doesn't mean you can't fight them, just be careful.

Hey, speaking of fighting... I want to see you in combat! Fight this simulacrum of mine. Show me what you've learned!
Why don't we play along with Armor? I've already added your new objective: Kill the simulacrum!

dialog.speaker: Watchman
dialog.text:
Command accepted!
Simulacrum is ready for combat.
Damn! I see your combat training has paid off.

You just completed your first mission. I know it was easy, but things won't always be so simple. Trust me.

Exit the building and we can wrap up your first assignment.

dialog.speaker: Armor
dialog.text:
Nice work, recruit! There's one more thing I wanted to tell you before you go.

Exile gangs have staked out territory in the Matrix, and might attack if you come close. Your targeting HUD colors their names based on their threat level. I won't go into all the details, but if you see purple, run!

I already see that it'll be a pleasure working with you, mxoemu3.

Contact me when you are ready for your next assignment, Warrior.

briefing_lines.text:
Greetings, {player}. An Exile named {target} has been executing attacks against our potential redpill recruitment efforts. We need this Exile's existence put to an end.

Head to this location and find {target}. Eliminate him at all costs. The best of luck to you, Warrior.

dialog_lines.text:
Excellent, professional work. I see that it will be a pleasure working with you, {player}.

Contact me when you are ready for your next assignment, Warrior.
Good news, {player}. Our target is alone and unaware. Complete your objectives and exit.
That's a confirmed kill. Tyndall should be pleased.
How did you find me? Get out of here!

briefing_lines.text:
We've experienced some backlash from a separate assignment -- a group of Exiles recently attacked one of our bases. Our operative, {npc}, was there when the strike took place. She is lucky to be alive! 

Meet with {npc} and get the statue from her. We need this statue transported to a safer location. Once you've left the area with the statue, I will update you with the drop-off point.
You're doing well, {player}. I'm sending you {npc}'s coordinates now. Deliver the statue to her.

dialog_lines.text:
I'm glad {npc} was able to hold off the Exiles until you arrived. 

{npc} will be fine. Just worry about the statue. Once you've exited the area I will send you the drop-off location.
Good, you're here. Tyndall told me to expect you. It isn't exactly safe here anymore, so we need this statue moved to a new location.
See to it that {npc} gets this. The statue is a Matrix artifact that has been around for many years now. We cannot allow this to fall into enemy hands!
{npc} is waiting for you. Identify yourself and get the statue from her.
Take the statue from {npc} by right-clicking the mouse and selecting the "Get" interaction.
{npc} is stationed at the Zion base inside this building. She'll take the statue from you.
Have you spoken to {npc} yet?

Those Exiles won't let up, will they? They insist on making trouble for us within the Matrix.

Well, enough of that... Do you have the statue with you?
That's her. You may give her the statue. To do this, right-click on her and select the "Give" interaction.
You're done here, {player}. Leave the area and Tyndall will debrief you.
Thank you, {player}. I'll secure the statue.
Maybe we'll get to work together in the future.
Hey, good to see you.
You have Zion's thanks, Warrior. Contact me when you are ready for your next assignment.

briefing_lines.text:
My wife, Dame White, is a constant thorn in my side, but she has her advantages. Her plans, however, cannot be allowed to interfere with my own. I happen to know that one of her operatives is meeting with informants in my organization. 

Get over there and make the traitors sorry they had anything to do with my wife. Recover whatever information they are exchanging.
